dimensions.assessment: Affects incarcerated victims and survivors of sexual abuse in federal, State, local, and Tribal detention facilities, as well as correctional officers and administrators.
dimensions.evidence: emotional support services or counseling for individuals who have experienced sexual abuse at any time in their life

dimensions.assessment: Provides targeted support services, training, and resources to improve handling of custodial sexual abuse trauma without altering fundamental criminal laws.
dimensions.evidence: award grants to emotional support service providers for the purpose of collaborating with Federal, State, local, or Tribal authorities

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes specific annual appropriations of $10 million for emotional support grants, $5 million for training grants, and $2 million for a resource center from FY 2027 through FY 2032.
dimensions.evidence: There are authorized to be appropriated $10,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2032 to carry out this section.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes new grant authorities and a national resource center administered by the Attorney General through the Office for Victims of Crime.
dimensions.evidence: The Attorney General shall establish a national resource center

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations and programs over a fixed six-year window from fiscal year 2027 through fiscal year 2032.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2032 to carry out this section.

missing_information: Actual amounts that will be appropriated annually by Congress.
importance_detail.rationale: Authorizes federal grant funding totaling $17 million annually across multiple grant programs and a resource center to provide emotional support services and training regarding sexual abuse in correctional facilities.
